names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 ianuarie, «Cuviosul Filotheos ctitorul».

death.note: The only date doxologia.ro gives him is in the heading of its own article on his page, «Cuviosul Filotheos ctitorul (sfârșitul secolului al X-lea)». The body of the page gives no year at all, so the interval is the century that heading names.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
